subject: Kickoff: generalized inlier voting for the localization core
body:
Hi team,

Kicking off the inlier-voting evaluation for the efficiency portfolio. Our AR anchoring pipeline spends most of its localization budget on RANSAC-style hypothesize-and-verify, and it falls over at high outlier ratios. The general voting approach from our open-source release is the alternative: the core algorithm in general_voter.h is application-independent, and the released 6DoF example solves calibrated-camera posing directly — exactly our anchoring problem shape.

Milestones (Mar 30 - Jun 22):
- Apr 24: build + reproduce the paper's tables (the repo ships create_table_2.sh / create_table_3.sh, so this should be mechanical)
- May 22: 6DoF posing on our own map data, accuracy vs the current RANSAC stack
- Jun 12: efficiency readout — latency, memory, and robustness at outlier ratios up to 95%

Ivo — resourcing please. Note the June benchmark sweep is the compute-heavy piece.

Zofia
